name: Rapid Fire: Ankur Warikoo and Papa CJ on Seekho
description:
This rapid fire with Ankur Warikoo was SO much fun. And what an absolute joy it was to share a meeting of the minds with such a wonderful, warm and inspiring human being who’s heart is in just the right place. 

The poetry section (yes there is one!) of this conversation is on Ankur's Insta.
